payload.title: A one-sentence why it matters for each public Reference
payload.description: Requested through the Machines on Machines session, 2026-11-05, ticket MOM-943ea6: each public finding shows a plain title and one sentence on why it matters. Today's summary is a raw page extract, and the tile does not publish it. Generated once on create or change, under the fact-checking standard (PPY-b32e85), published through the tile for sites to draw. Open with Ryan: every Reference or only accepted ones, and the model; the default for LLM tasks is GPT-6 Luna. No scheduled pass.
